step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an AWS infrastructure centered around containerized application workloads running in VPCs managed via Transit Gateway and integrated with on-premises Data Centers. On-premises Data Centers in Texas and Washington connect to AWS via Transit Gateway. The application VPC contains Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) routing traffic to Amazon EC2 nodes running Kubernetes containers. The applications utilize Amazon RDS for database persistence, Amazon S3 for object storage, and Amazon CloudWatch for observability and metrics monitoring.

graph.name: T-Mobile Standardized Kubernetes and Immutable Infrastructure on AWS
graph.notes: T-Mobile uses automated GitOps workflows with Terraform and Ansible to deploy standardized Kubernetes clusters on EC2 and ELB across regions and local zones, connected via Transit Gateway to on-premises data centers.
